Package Models

Class OrderExecutionPhase

java.lang.Object
Models.Phase
Models.OrderExecutionPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OrderExecutionPhase extends Phase
The OrderExecutionPhase class represents the phase in the game where orders are executed. During this phase, players' orders are executed based on the game rules and conditions. This phase typically follows the order submission phase in a game turn.

This class extends the Phase class and inherits its properties and behaviors. It implements the specific functionality required for the order execution phase.

Example usage:

     OrderExecutionPhase executionPhase = new OrderExecutionPhase();
     executionPhase.executeOrders(gameState);

  • Constructor Details

    • OrderExecutionPhase

      public OrderExecutionPhase(GameEngine p_gameEngine, GameState p_gameState)
      Constructs a new OrderExecutionPhase object with the specified game engine and game state.

      This constructor initializes the order execution phase with the provided game engine and game state. The game engine is responsible for managing the game flow and rules, while the game state holds the current state of the game, including player information and the game board.

      Parameters:
      p_gameEngine - The game engine responsible for managing the game flow and rules.
      p_gameState - The game state holding the current state of the game, including player information and the game board.

    • checkEndOftheGame

      protected Boolean checkEndOftheGame(GameState p_gameState)
      Checks whether the game has ended by determining if any player has conquered all countries on the map. If a player has conquered all countries, sets the game winner and logs the end of the game.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current state of the game.
      Returns:
      True if the game has ended, false otherwise.
